seo.ogTitle: Moving Junk Removal in Mobile, AL — Zoiris Junk Removal
seo.ogDescription: Lighten the load before your move, or clear what is left after. Junk hauling timed around your moving day in Mobile, Alabama.

purpose: Serve people moving into, out of, or within Mobile who want to get rid of what they are not taking, either before movers arrive (to pack and pay less) or after the truck leaves (to hand over a clear home). The page is organized around timing decisions relative to moving day.

content.lead: Every move turns up things that are not worth packing: the worn-out couch, the spare-room mattress, the boxes that went straight from the last move into a closet. Zoiris Junk Removal hauls those away for households and businesses moving in Mobile, Alabama. We can come before the movers, so you pack less, or after the truck pulls away, so the old place is empty when you hand over the keys.

quickAnswer.question: Should I get rid of junk before or after the movers come?
quickAnswer.answer: Before, if you can. Every piece you do not keep is one less thing to wrap, load, and pay to move. Plenty of people also book us for after the truck leaves, to clear whatever was left behind. If you are not sure, tell us your moving date and we will help you pick a pickup window on the right side of it.

includes.heading: How we help around a move
includes.intro: Moving junk removal is mostly about timing. There are three common ways to use it:
points: **Before the move:** we take furniture, mattresses, and boxes you have decided not to bring, so the movers only handle what is going to the new place.
**After the move:** we clear what is left at the old home or apartment, such as leftover furniture, the garage shelf nobody claimed, and the pile by the door.
**After you unpack:** we pick up flattened moving boxes, packing paper, and the old furniture your new pieces replaced.
In every case, we separate usable and recyclable items from disposal where practical options exist.

items.heading: What people leave behind when they move
items.intro: These are the items that most often do not make the cut:
list: Sofas, sectionals, and recliners that will not fit the new layout
Mattresses, box springs, and bed frames being replaced
Dressers, entertainment centers, and bulky bookcases
Moving boxes, packing paper, and boxed items you no longer need
Patio furniture and grills (with the propane tank removed)
Washers and dryers that are not coming along

audience.heading: Who uses moving junk removal
body: Homeowners and renters moving across town, downsizing into a smaller place, or leaving Mobile entirely. People relocating for a new job often need the old home cleared after they are already gone.

Businesses moving to a new office use it too, to avoid paying movers for furniture that will not be used. Larger office moves are covered under [office cleanouts](/services/office-cleanouts/), and apartment move-outs under [apartment cleanouts](/services/apartment-cleanouts/).

process.heading: How to time it around your move

steps.title: Share your moving date
steps.body: Send a [pickup request](/request-pickup/) with your moving date, any closing or lease-end date, and a list or photos of what is not coming.

steps.title: Choose your side of moving day
steps.body: We confirm an estimate and a pickup window before or after the movers, leaving a buffer so the two crews are not in each other's way.

steps.title: Haul it off
steps.body: Our crew carries out the items you have flagged and leaves everything else for the movers or for you. If you are already gone, we confirm access ahead of time and let you know when it is done.

pricingFactors.heading: What affects the cost of moving junk removal
pricingFactors.intro: We quote each job individually. For moves, the main factors are:
factors: How much is staying behind, from a few pieces to most of a household
Large or heavy furniture compared with boxes and bags
Stairs, elevators, and how far the truck is from the door
Whether everything is grouped in one spot or spread through the home
Coordinating two visits, one before the move and one after, if you need both

prepare.heading: Tips for a smooth move-out cleanout
tips: Walk through each room with your moving list and put a "not moving" sticker on everything that stays behind.
If you can, group the not-moving items in one room or the garage. It keeps movers from packing them by mistake.
Leave a day or more between the junk pickup and your closing or key handover, so a delay does not put your deadline at risk.
Keep moving boxes for the new place apart from the empty boxes and trash you want gone.
Do not pack paint, propane, or fuel for us to take. These stay with you, and most movers will not load them either.
If you will have left town, arrange a lockbox or a neighbor with a key, and tell us in advance.

restrictions.heading: Good to know before moving day
restrictions.body: Moves bring a few common questions to settle ahead of time:
list: We do not move belongings to your new home. Everything we take is hauled away for reuse, recycling, or disposal.
Refrigerators and freezers need a call to confirm. Empty and defrost them a day ahead.
Gas dryers and gas stoves must be disconnected by a qualified person before pickup.
Propane tanks, paint, and fuel left in the garage are not accepted.

faqs.q: Can you pick up moving boxes after I unpack?
faqs.a: Yes. Flatten the boxes if you can and bag the packing paper. Tell us roughly how many there are. A big stack of cardboard takes more truck space than you might expect.

faqs.q: Can you clear my old house after I've already moved away?
faqs.a: Yes, if access is arranged. A lockbox, a neighbor with a key, or your realtor can let us in. Tell us exactly what is staying, such as appliances included in the sale, so nothing goes that should not.

faqs.q: Will you take what my movers wouldn't?
faqs.a: Usually, yes, as long as it is not hazardous. Furniture, mattresses, and boxed items are fine. Movers often refuse propane, fuel, and chemicals, and we cannot take those either.

faqs.q: How far ahead of the movers should I schedule?
faqs.a: Give yourself a few days before the moving truck arrives. That way the house is clear for packing, and there is still time to adjust if anything changes.

faqs.q: I'm moving out of an apartment. Is that different?
faqs.a: The process is the same, but stairs, elevators, and building rules come into play. Our [apartment cleanouts](/services/apartment-cleanouts/) page covers those details.

content.areaNote: Moving junk removal is offered for homes and businesses in the City of Mobile. If you are moving from somewhere outside the city, ask us first.
